questions.stem: A 6-month-old boy begins experiencing vomiting, night sweats, and tremors after the introduction of fruit juices into his diet during weaning. Physical examination reveals significant hepatomegaly. Urine tests are positive for reducing sugars but negative for glucose. Which enzyme deficiency is most likely responsible for these symptoms?
